Highground, Fatehgarh Anantnag-192101 Jammu & Kashmir

NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their application form in
response to Advertisement Notice No. F (Advt-Appt-Cont-2026-NUR) DAA/KU-06, dated 15-01-
2026 for the contractual positions at Institute of Nursing & Institute of Paramedical Sciences,
South Campus, University of Kashmir, that the provisional list of applicants along with their
eligibility status is given in Annexure I, II and III, IV respectively to this Notice.
In case of objection/discrepancy (if any), the candidate/s are advised to approach office of
Director, South Campus up to 07-04-2026 during office hours along with documentary
evidence.
Sd/-
Director
